geometry.derivationNote: Treaty Articles 1-2 directly provide three WGS84 points, prescribe straight rhumb-line segments (loxodromes), and state that coordinates prevail over the appended maps. Rendering densification follows the rhumb line in Mercator space and does not alter source points.
